# truenas_vm (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS VM by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VM name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `autostart` (Boolean)
- `bootloader` (String)
- `cores` (Number)
- `cpu_mode` (String)
- `cpu_model` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) Numeric VM ID.
- `memory` (Number) Memory allocated to the VM, in bytes.
- `min_memory` (Number) Minimum memory for ballooning, in bytes (0 = unset).
- `running` (Boolean)
- `shutdown_timeout` (Number)
- `status` (String) Current VM status: RUNNING, STOPPED.
- `threads` (Number)
- `time` (String)
- `vcpus` (Number)
